ops.oldText: Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
ops.newText: Customer is not required to disclose or match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have flipped the operator in Section 7.2 so that we are not required to disclose or match third-party offers before engaging another provider; as drafted it was a de facto exclusivity/right of first refusal on us, and our playbook accepts no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the customer. This also aligns 7.2 with Section 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment.
proposal.summary: Negate the Section 7.2 disclose-and-match obligation so no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Customer.
